zoe: Heads-up: PR #2550 updates cross-language SDK snippets (py/ts/go) for streaming + pagination + retries. CI caught a couple of lint and behavior issues. Can folks help review? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2550
docs-ci: Lint: examples/python/streaming.md missing language tag; examples/ts/pagination.md expects cursor falsy handling.
mike: I'll fix the TS pagination. Reminder: server may return "" or null for final cursor so check falsy. I'll add a comment + short backpressure tip.
arda: I'll take Python and Go. Python needs an async iterator sample and small tenacity retry; Go should show context cancellation and a recv loop that handles EOF and transient errors.
mike: TS draft:```ts
// treat empty string || null as end
let cursor: string | null = null;
do { const r = await client.items.list({ cursor }); rows.push(...r.items); cursor = r.cursor || null; } while (cursor);
```
arda: Python draft:```python
from tenacity import retry, wait_exponential
@retry(wait=wait_exponential(min=0.5, max=3))
async def collect(prompt):
  async for t in client.stream.tokens(prompt=prompt):
    buf.append(t.content)
```
arda: Go draft uses ctx and channel to allow cancel: brief example pushed.
devex: Can we consolidate these into a single streaming guide with a migration note (v1->v2 client signature + cursor semantics)? I'll add the blurb.
docs-ci: Re-run queued after pushes.
zoe: Thanks everyone  will merge when CI green and wording polished.
